items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Well, that was our boy. We used to go to him for everything.

ctx.x: He's down on Governor Nichols or something. Yeah.

Well, that was our boy. We used to go to him for everything. Well, Dave O'Connor is a representative for the Imperial Recording Company and I think they do business together. So every section that he had, we have it down there at the J and M.

I was going to ask, did Joe Turner work around here or anything much? At the Dew Drop. At the Dew Drop. Every time he was here last year. I know he came in just a little spot job there then. Yeah, I know. I wonder, did he used to live here for a while? No, no, no, no.
